content.outro: The charter lies on the steward's table, ready for the new masters at dawn. Both keys are back on their hooks, a hall apart.
content.premise: The Staple Hall at Marrowby keeps its charter in a strongroom with two locks. By the guild's oldest rule the Warden's key hangs in the counting room and the Clerk's key lies in the archive, and the steward who keeps the door may hold neither. The new masters are sworn in at dawn, and the charter has to be brought out tonight.
content.theme: A guild strongroom with two locks, whose two keys are kept in two rooms so that no one pair of hands can open it alone.
content.title: Two Keys
